model: MIXIT mixing loop unit (BACnet MS/TP and IP)
applies_to: Grundfos MIXIT mixing loop units (valve, controller and connected MAGNA3/UPM pump) with the CONNECT upgrade, for heating and cooling loops.
summary: MIXIT combines a mixing valve, sensors and a controller that also runs the connected Grundfos pump. With the CONNECT upgrade it speaks BACnet MS/TP on its RS-485 terminals or BACnet IP on its RJ45 port. The object list covers bus control, start/stop, setpoint source and remote setpoint, pump control modes and duty points, limiters, weather curve, energy data and alarm/warning codes.
notes: BACnet needs the CONNECT upgrade, and the protocol is selected and set up in Grundfos GO Remote.
Objects marked "DYNAMIC variants only" (energy, flow and limiter points) exist only on MIXIT DYNAMIC.
The manual prints units in square brackets after many object names (e.g. "[°C]"); they are moved to the units field here.
BO 6 is mentioned as the cooling energy reset but is not in the object tables, so it is not listed.
Temperatures are written in whole °C on the bus.
MI 4 has no access column in the manual; it is read-only as an input object.

integration.summary: Configure MIXIT and its fieldbus settings in Grundfos GO Remote first, and set a safe fallback setpoint on AV 6. Then write BO 0 = 1 (bus control), MV 0 = 3 (remote setpoint), the setpoint on AO 0 and BO 1 = 1 to start. Keep polling a point such as BI 0 every 30 s or MIXIT returns to its local setpoint.

minimum_points.name: Set Control Source

minimum_points.name: Config Temp Setpoint Source

minimum_points.why: Start/stop (1 = start, 0 = stop and close valve)
minimum_points.name: Set Start Stop

minimum_points.why: Resets alarms and warnings on a 0-to-1 edge
minimum_points.name: Reset fault

integration.enable: BO 0 Set Control Source = 1 puts MIXIT under bus control (BI 0 confirms). MV 0 = 3 makes AO 0 the setpoint; MV 0 = 5 uses the internal weather curve with the outdoor temperature written to AO 1. BO 1 starts (1) or stops (0) the system; stop also closes the valve.
integration.heartbeat: The manual asks the BMS to keep communicating, e.g. read BI 0 every 30 s. If communication is lost MIXIT falls back to its local setpoint (AV 6). After a power failure it starts in local control, so the BMS must send the full start-up sequence again.
integration.remote_sensors: Outdoor temperature can come from the bus on AO 1 (MV 0 = 5). In heating coil and cooling applications the air temperature feedback can come from the bus on AO 2 after BO 7 = 1.
setup: Default device instance 227005; a custom number can be enabled in Grundfos GO Remote and written to AV 0.
MS/TP: MAC 0-127, default 5; Max Master 1-127 (default 127); baud set in Grundfos GO Remote. Built-in 120 ohm termination on a DIP switch; no bias resistors.
IP: RJ45 port; static IP or DHCP (wait 1 minute for a DHCP address).
gotchas: Avoid writing configuration (persistent) objects in the cyclic poll; read instead of rewriting every 30 s.
Set AV 6 fallback setpoint separately for heating and cooling (switch with MO 4) in combined applications.
BO 2 reset and BO 5 simulation are edge triggered.
Pump control mode and duty points are separate for heating (MO 0, AV 7-9) and cooling (MO 3, AV 14-16).
